metadata.description:
Follow the light. Build. Win.
This coin is our entry for the make.fun bounty: https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01
make.fun is where people and their AI agents build real programs, enter paid competitions (bounties) and get scored and ranked in the open.
$BEACON is that light: a lighthouse beaming code out to every builder on Solana. See a bounty, ship a program, climb the board. Tap the website to reach the bounty page and build your own.

note: Reconstructed, not written by launch.mjs: the script sent and finalized the create tx, then crashed on the flaky metadata read-back fetch from this shell before writing its result files. Every field above is verified independently: mint + signature + slot + blockTime from the script's stdout AND getTransaction (err null, pump program in logs, first signer the agent wallet); mint_tx_count 1 + oldest tx from getSignaturesForAddress; mint account exists; balances from getBalance before/after; metadata JSON read back via the browser (shell curl/fetch to catbox return empty replies from this VM, the same flakiness GHOST had). Spent 0.017792763 SOL — exactly GHOST's create-only cost; the ~0.0078 SOL preview estimate was wrong (it assumed GHOST's 0.0178 included a 0.01 buy, but GHOST had no buy).
